cards.text: Friend, we're in Jerusalem. The apostles, the men Jesus chose to carry His message, are performing many signs and wonders among the people. And the believers gather together with one accord in a place called Solomon's Colonnade.
The people regard them highly, but no one else dares to join them. It's karaoke night, friend: everybody's cheering, and NOBODY wants the mic.

cards.question: The believers are meeting in Solomon's Colonnade. During this time, what happens to the number of believers brought to the Lord?

cards.text: Then people carry the sick out into the streets and lay them on cots and mats. They line them up right where Peter, one of the apostles, will be passing by.

cards.question: The sick are lined up in the streets. As Peter passes by, what are the people hoping will at least fall on some of them?

cards.text: Folks are lining up for the man's SHADOW, friend, and my shadow's only ever blocked the oven light. And now crowds come in from the towns around Jerusalem too, bringing the sick and those tormented by unclean spirits.

cards.question: Crowds bring the sick and the tormented in from the towns around Jerusalem. True or false: all of them are healed.

cards.text: Then the high priest and all his associates, who belong to a group called the Sadducees, are filled with jealousy.

cards.question: The high priest and his associates are filled with jealousy. What do they go out and do?

answers.text: Arrest the apostles and put them in jail
Invite the apostles to teach at the temple
Send the apostles away from Jerusalem

cards.question: During the night, the jail doors are opened and an ___ brings the apostles out.
The apostles are out of the jail. What does the angel of the Lord tell them to do?

answers.text: Go tell the full message of new life in the temple courts
Go hide outside the city until the danger passes
Go home and keep quiet about what happened tonight

cards.text: So at daybreak they walk right into the temple courts, just as they'd been told, and start teaching the people. An angel opening doors in the night to bring somebody out is a night I KNOW, friend, because that's how an angel called me out of a junk drawer.

Meanwhile the high priest and his associates arrive, call together the Sanhedrin, the full assembly of the elders of Israel, and send to the jail for the apostles. Big meeting, everybody in their seats, and the guests of honor are... elsewhere.

cards.question: The officers get to the jail to bring the apostles before the Sanhedrin. True or false: they find the jail doors broken open.
Jail locked, guards at the doors, nobody inside. When the captain of the temple guard and the chief priests hear that, they're ___ about what's happening.

cards.text: Then someone comes in and announces, "Look, the men you put in jail are standing in the temple courts teaching the people!" You lock them up for the night, and by sunup they're back on the job.

cards.question: The captain of the temple guard heads out with his officers to bring the apostles in. True or false: they drag the apostles in by force.
The captain and his officers bring the apostles in without using force. Why?

answers.text: They fear the people will stone them
The angel warned them to be gentle
The high priest ordered it that way

cards.text: The apostles are made to stand before the Sanhedrin, and the high priest starts questioning them. It's getting called into the boss's office, except the boss brought the ENTIRE assembly.

"We gave you strict orders not to teach in this name," he tells them, and yet they've filled Jerusalem with their teaching. That's saying "don't post about it" and finding it in every group chat you're in.

cards.question: The high priest has one more charge against the apostles. What does he say they're determined to do?

answers.text: Make the Council responsible for this man's blood
Turn the whole city against the temple guards
Take over the temple courts from the priests

cards.question: Peter and the other apostles answer the high priest. What do they say they must do?

answers.text: Obey the people rather than rulers

cards.text: Then the apostles tell the Council that the God of their fathers raised up Jesus, "whom you had killed by hanging Him on a tree."

cards.question: The apostles say God exalted Jesus to His right hand as Prince and Savior. What do they say God did that for?

answers.text: To grant Israel repentance and forgiveness
To bring judgment on the whole Council
To restore the temple in Jerusalem

cards.question: The apostles tell the Council they are witnesses of all this about Jesus. True or false: they say the Holy Spirit is a witness too.

cards.text: When the Council members hear this, they're enraged. They resolve to put the apostles to death.
But a Pharisee named Gamaliel stands up in the Sanhedrin. He's a teacher of the law, honored by all the people.

cards.question: Before he says a word to the Council, Gamaliel orders that the apostles be put ___ for a short time.

cards.text: Gamaliel tells the Council to think carefully about what they're about to do, and reminds them of a man named Theudas, who claimed to be somebody and had about four hundred men join him. Theudas was killed, his followers were dispersed, and it all came to nothing.

cards.question: After Theudas, a man called Judas the Galilean (not Judas Iscariot) drew people after him, and he perished too. True or false: Gamaliel says Judas's followers stayed together.
So Gamaliel's advice is to leave the apostles alone. If their purpose is of human origin, he says, it will ___.
But if the apostles' purpose is from God, Gamaliel says the Council won't be able to stop the apostles. What might the Council even find themselves doing?

cards.text: The Council yields to Gamaliel. One man talks a furious room down, and friend, I can't even talk a lump of dough into behaving.
They call the apostles back in and have them flogged. Then they order them not to speak in the name of Jesus.

cards.question: The Council has flogged the apostles and ordered them not to speak in Jesus's name. True or false: the Council lets the apostles go.
The apostles leave the Sanhedrin ___, because they've been counted worthy of suffering disgrace for the Name.
The apostles have been flogged and ordered again not to speak in Jesus's name. True or false: after this, they stop teaching in the temple courts.

cards.text: Every day, in the temple courts and from house to house, they keep teaching and proclaiming the good news that Jesus is the Christ. Told to stop talking, and they go DOOR TO DOOR.
